changelog:
v5.1.0 — Browse Movies & Series by decade and genre

• Movies: a new "Browse by" section in the sidebar lets you pick a decade — 2020s, 2010s, 2000s, 90s, 80s, 70s, or Classics.

• Series: browse by genre (Drama, Comedy, Animation, Documentary, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Crime and more) or by decade.

• The sidebar is tidier: every service shows how many titles it has, the smallest ones are tucked under "More services", and "Unlabeled" is now "All Other Movies / Series".

• Recently Added now shows only titles added in the last two weeks, newest first.

• Faster: the movie and series lists load once and are shared across Home, Movies and Series instead of being downloaded again on every screen.

Includes everything from v5.0.3: adult content kept off the Home screen and the parental-controls PIN fix for older sticks.
